reason: Proposes backward self-verification to score candidate CoT answers but reports only arithmetic/commonsense/logical reasoning accuracy; no claim about the verifier itself.
Multi-turn RL structuring reasoning as iterative generation-verification turns; claims about turn-level credit assignment and scaling to 20+ inference turns. Mechanism: verification.
Interview/survey study of 51 professionals on output format and semantic constraints; single-pass generation, no iterative control.
Self-verification as a confidence signal for selective prediction on single-turn multiple-choice QA; audit-then-abstain, control never returns.
Sub-question verification selects among sampled agentic-search trajectories; claims are BrowseComp/benchmark accuracy points, not evidence about the verification mechanism.
Measures a two-model dialogue loop over fixed turns with lexical and embedding drift metrics, reporting repetition/convergence as a stuck-loop property. Mechanism: termination.
Online RL that trains solving and self-verification jointly; the critique feeds policy updates during training, no runtime revision loop.
Provenance model and capture system for agentic workflows; claims are provenance-query support and reliability analysis, not how the loop proceeds.
Fine-tuned post-processing model plus constrained decoding for schema-conformant output; one-shot transformation with no loop.
Test-time refinement where the model verifies its reasoning and rethinks trajectories, gated by confidence-aware decoding; self-correction efficiency is the claim. Mechanism: verification.
LLM-refined Python policies improved from execution traces, but reported claims are Atari scores versus deep RL baselines and training cost.
Fuses generation and verification into a single generation pass and speeds up RL training; no runtime loop that goes again.
Philosophy-of-language argument on whether chatbot utterances are meaningful; no agent loop of any kind.
Gene-set analysis agent verifying its output against biological databases; claims are description accuracy versus GPT-4 and expert review, i.e. task outcomes.
Duplicate of the Self-Verification paper: backward verification scores candidate answers but evidence is only end-task reasoning accuracy.
Empirical study measuring ChatGPT's self-verification across generation, completion and repair, reporting its failure rates and self-contradiction. Mechanism: verification.
Abstract is a bibliographic stub; title names a study of LLM self-verification abilities in logical reasoning as the contribution. Mechanism: verification.
Self-verification via contrastive self-asking for tool selection, but the only reported evidence is a 22% ToolBench improvement over few-shot baselines.
Open platform standardising tool interaction for AI scientists; claims are tool coverage and end-to-end case studies, not loop control.
Taxonomic survey synthesising over 300 studies of hallucination mitigation techniques.
Decomposes verification into step-by-step subprocesses via Natural Program and reports the rigor of the verified reasoning steps themselves. Mechanism: verification.
Consensus-entropy verification signal evaluated as a verifier (+42.1% F1 over VLM-as-Judge) and driving adaptive routing. Mechanism: verification.
Multi-agent debate framework for zero-shot NER/RE; claims are extraction accuracy over zero-shot baselines and inference cost.
Pre-generation classifier estimating a query's hallucination propensity; rewriting/ranking/routing happen before generation, no iterative control.
Embodied vision-language programmer plus benchmark suite trained with environment feedback; claims are task performance in OctoVerse simulators.
Argues and evidences that output-refinement and policy-refinement feedback loops cause in-context reward hacking, and that static evaluation misses it. Mechanism: iteration policy.
Evaluates o1 planning/scheduling and adds external verifiers; reported claims are benchmark success and inference cost, not properties of the verify-replan loop.
Self-verification of a small model's answer drives a POMDP router deciding whether to re-run on a larger model; cost-performance of that policy is measured. Mechanism: iteration policy.
Multi-agent cognitive reasoning with a verifying coordinator; claims are EmoBench emotional-intelligence scores.
Survey of reasoning techniques, evaluation methods and benchmarks in LLMs.
Synthetic coding dataset validated by a self-verification pipeline; the contribution is training data and fine-tuned model scores, with no runtime loop.
Prompt-design study for LLM anomaly detection in cyber-physical datasets using RAG; two-step prompting with no iterative control.
Compares single attempt, self-debugging, and self-debugging with self-verification on 80 routing problems and reports each configuration's effect. Mechanism: retry/repair.
Chain-of-Verification drafts, plans and independently answers verification questions, then revises; hallucination reduction attributed to that cycle. Mechanism: verification.
Jailbreak attack eliciting harmful output via fallacious-procedure prompts; single-pass prompting, no loop.
Multilingual ophthalmology benchmark plus a reflective RAG/self-verification debiasing system; claims are clinical QA accuracy and bias gaps.
Secondary synthesis comparing self-verification, multi-agent verification and retrieval using evidence from existing benchmarks and studies.
Conceptual framework built from a structured literature synthesis (2018-2025) and descriptive analysis of 14 decentralized-science projects.
Philosophical thesis that hallucination stems from lacking propositional representation; no agent loop or iterative control.
Reward redistribution and credit assignment for episodic reinforcement learning; the loop studied is the RL training loop, not a language-model agent's control loop.
Multi-agent framework with meta-planner and run-time monitor, but the reported claim is performance on two scheduling problems.
Pareto-optimal risk score estimating LLM error probability; a post-hoc estimator over single responses, no iterative control.
Planning pipeline formalising queries for SAT solvers; claims are TravelPlanner success rates and unsatisfiable-query handling, i.e. task outcomes.
Two-layer medical summarisation and LLM-as-judge evaluation framework; claims are summary quality and agreement with clinical experts.
